propositions: Four agentic criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 executions due to missing vocabulary triggers, requiring deterministic pre-filters to skip non-matching plans before LLM routing.

Deterministic gates implement conjunctive regex matching on plan text, file_impact glob matching, and file_impact reason regex matching without reinvoking applicability judgment — the LLM router remains the authority for fired plans.
Skipped plans are recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated with criterion id and rule name to provide visibility into gating decisions in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

Asserted-capability fires only when both text legs (module-ref and capability-verb) match; other criteria fire on text-all conjunction OR file_impact arms, enabling detection of removal work by file_impact reason vocabulary and scheduler/workflow changes by .github and Makefile globs.
